description: This Java class 'EntityWhereString' implements the 'EntityCondition' interface and represents a raw SQL string condition used in database queries within the Apache OFBiz framework. It encapsulates SQL expressions for WHERE clause snippets, with methods for validation, comparison, and visitor pattern acceptance.

classes.name: EntityWhereString
classes.description: A final class implementing EntityCondition that encapsulates a raw SQL string for use in query conditions.

methods.name: EntityWhereString
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with a raw SQL string.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the stored SQL string is empty or null.

methods.name: makeWhereString
methods.description: Returns the stored SQL string as the WHERE clause snippet.

methods.name: checkCondition
methods.description: Performs validation on the model entity; here it does nothing and assumes always valid.

methods.name: entityMatches
methods.description: Throws UnsupportedOperationException; cannot evaluate entity match for raw SQL string.

methods.name: mapMatches
methods.description: Throws UnsupportedOperationException; cannot evaluate map match for raw SQL string.

methods.name: getWhereString
methods.description: Returns the embedded raw SQL string.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on the SQL string content.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates hash code based on the SQL string.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the object, which is the SQL string.
